title: The Fire-Pit Opens
pitch: A mountain-sized fire sacrifice by terrified gods splits the ground and Tripura Sundari rises out of it on a chariot taller than the flames.
hook_first_second: Black screen, a crack of orange light splits the frame and a giant crowned hand clears the rim.
beats: Gods chant around a huge pit as the sky darkens
Fire collapses inward into a pure white point
A crowned girl-goddess rises on a chariot, flames bending away from her
Camera pulls back to show the pit is the size of a lake
payoff: Her eyes open and every flame in the valley turns rose-gold.
loop: Flames pour back into the pit and the crack closes to the same black screen.
seed: Chidagni Kunda birth, Lalitopakhyana (Brahmanda Purana) via dossier
send_trigger: Tag the friend who always shows up at the worst moment and saves everything.

title: Bhandasura's Army Meets One Smile

beats: Army floods a plain to the edge of sight
She sits on the lotus without moving
Front rank freezes, the rank behind crashes into it
Armour begins to melt into rose petals from the front line backwards
payoff: The whole army is a field of petals and she is still smiling.
loop: Petals blow back up into spears and the charge starts again.
seed: Bhandasura war, Lalitopakhyana (Brahmanda Purana) via dossier
send_trigger: Send to someone whose calm wins every argument.

title: Sri Chakra Unfolds Into a City

Lines lift and become walls, towers, bridges
Camera dives down the central tower into her throne room
payoff: She sits where the dot was, the whole city built around her.
loop: City folds back to a single dot.
seed: Sri Chakra as her body (Yoginihridaya via dossier); Sri Nagara

beats: Swans burst out of mist pulling a gold chariot
Thirty demons rise from the ground in a ring
Bala draws her sugarcane bow, arrows fly in a fan
Each demon turns into a lotus bud
payoff: Thirty lotuses stand where the demons were and open at once.

She turns her head toward it

loop: Colour drains back to ash as she turns away.
